CHD.why: A consumer staples leader breaking to a new closing high on heavy volume, its averages lined up in order and a rising weekly trend.
CHD.contested: Contested: the trigger buys the price at the high with no pullback, and the objection wants the dip to the short-term average; it clears if the break holds and the stock bases above the pivot.

CHYM.why: A financial leader with top-tier relative strength on very heavy volume, its averages in order, already well past its pivot.
CHYM.contested: Contested: the trigger buys an extension well past the pivot; it clears on a pullback to the short-term average and a close back above it, or a fresh tight pivot.

LFST.why: A healthcare leader with top-tier relative strength building a base under its pivot, its averages in order.
LFST.contested: Contested: the trigger waits for the base breakout, while part of the room buys the pullback turning or a fresh momentum signal; it clears on a handle and a daily close over the pivot on heavy volume.

HUM.why: A healthcare leader at its yearly high with its averages in order, slated as a watch before the quality check.
HUM.contested: Rejected: the trigger rested an order at the short-term average while the stock sits at its high, with no volume test; it would change on an hourly close above yesterday's high on heavy volume.

HNGE.why: A healthcare leader with top-tier relative strength on a reclaim day, slated as a buy before the quality check.
HNGE.contested: Rejected: the hourly trigger buys inside the pullback, not the pivot break, with the stock far above its long-term average; it would change on a daily close above the pivot on expanding volume.

GKOS.why: A healthcare name near its yearly high that survived cross-examination.
GKOS.contested: Not slated: it survived cross-examination but the room did not carry it to the slate.

STGW.why: A communication services name near its yearly high that survived cross-examination.
STGW.contested: Not slated: it survived cross-examination but the room did not carry it to the slate.

RBRK.why: A held long carried into the room to ask the add question; no case to add was filed.
RBRK.contested: Not slated: no analyst filed a case for it at cross-examination, so the hold rests on the broker stop.

SPCX.why: A held short carried into the room; the one case for it could not be tested by the long-only reviewers.
SPCX.contested: Not slated: the case was dropped at cross-examination, so the only line is the live broker buy stop.
